annotations.text:
Open: one effect per template, or several?

Drafted as one. "Amber Breathe" is one named thing; two effects together is what a Look with deferred effects already is.

Open: the default speed master.

Drafted as "By usage": the project master whose usage matches the family. This gives the busk plan's D1 routing its first caller. Alternative: plain M1 default, as the Add Effect sheet has today.

Open: what a plain click does on an effect chip in the programmer strip.

Drafted as "mint a programmer-band copy" (the + Effect path), so click/⌥click mean the same as for a value chip. Alternative: both gestures add a layer, and the copy path is only Save as template.
Beam cannot hold an effect: the effect library has dimmer, colour and position categories only. The Effect choice under Holds is disabled under Beam, and the Beam busk column has no Effects hairline.
